items.headline:
US headline CPI (MoM) fell 0.4% in June, well below the -0.1% forecast, while annual inflation eased to 3.5% (vs. 3.8% expected).

Core CPI (MoM) was flat at 0.0%, missing the 0.2% estimate and signaling softer underlying inflation.

Core CPI (YoY) slowed to 2.6%, below the 2.8%
